## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue (use `Fixes #123` only when fully resolved; otherwise `Refs #123`).

## Evidence and validation

List checks actually run and their results. For reconstruction, include TU IDs, binary evidence, compile/parity/review results and any platform adaptations. For visible changes, include before/after screenshots or video. For documentation, check links and instructions.

## Dependencies or remaining work

Link paired workflow changes, build mounts or asset-converter fixes. Mention untested behavior and follow-up work. Write none if complete.
